# Product Hunt

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 6 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: a public product leaderboard: coral pill actions on a white page, a system sans stack, a ranked list with a square vote control, and a signed-out OAuth login card.

Captured 2026-11-18, signed out (public pages only; OAuth login was not entered; the newsletter email form was submitted and the confirmation link did not complete; votes and follows were not clicked). Themes: light.

Public signed-out surfaces of [producthunt.com](https://www.producthunt.com/), captured on 2026-11-18 from computed styles in the T3 preview browser. No account was created. The daily newsletter form accepted `kaichen@agentmail.to` and asked for a confirmation click. Themes observed: light. Widths measured: 1440 and 390 CSS pixels, both at devicePixelRatio 2.

The roles below are the catalog's swatches for the `light` theme. The front matter then lists every colour token under `light`, named by its path with dots turned into hyphens.

8 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: -apple-system.

The computed family is `-apple-system, system-ui, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif`, plus the emoji fonts. No webfont was loaded for the UI. The tokens drop the emoji fonts and keep the text stack. The licence is the system font licence on the machine that renders the page.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

Dark tokens are declared on `:is(.dark, :has(.dark:not(.theme-isolate)) .theme-mirror)`. No element was painted with that class, so those values were not computed. The 24px spacing step is derived from 16px and 8px. `ease-out` is expanded to control points. Screenshot-backed crops do not exist. The header height computed to 85.4px at 1440 while the stylesheet says 86px above 1099px. Body line-height computed to 18.4px while links computed to 24px.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the coral only for the action.** Sign in, the filled Subscribe, View all, and the logo disc are `#ff6154`. Navigation text stays `#344054`.
- **Keep buttons fully round.** The primary button, the outline Subscribe, search, product tabs, and the newsletter field all computed `border-radius: 9999px`.
- **Leave the vote button unpressed in a signed-out mock.** The 52px vote control shows a count. Clicking it was not done, because a vote needs an account.
- **Do not invent a dark theme from the light page.** Dark custom properties exist. They were not on screen.
